metricDefinitions.meanInteractivity: 1 / mean full-response ITL seconds rounded to5 decimal places; not P90 or mean of individual request rates
metricDefinitions.totalThroughput: formal input+output tokens / original observed benchmark duration, total per replica
metricDefinitions.legacyAgenticLatencyFields: Unprefixed ttft/endToEnd retain the app's P90 semantics; mean values remain in evidence.
metricDefinitions.mape: 100 * arithmetic mean(abs(simulation/reference -1)) over the fixed nine matched configurations; no nearest-frontier matching or pooled-token weighting
